candidates.rawApprovedRecord: Episodes on ISTV are guaranteed for 5 years. The only reasons for removal are selling the company, closing the company, or the client doing something bad. Conditions: Applies to ISTV only.; Removal only under three specific conditions: company sale, company closure, or client misconduct. Boundaries: Does not apply to other products like Diamond.; Does not guarantee the episode will not be removed for other reasons not listed.

Policy context: Can Legacy Makers or other ISTV episodes include two people?. Decision evidence: Yes, as long as whoever wants to film is on the call and studio/fulfillment/production has notice through onboarding.

Clients do not choose which streaming platform their show is submitted to. Placement is guaranteed on Roku, Apple TV, and Fire TV via the ISTV app. Amazon placement is only for VIP licenses and is not guaranteed due to Amazon's own approval process, though all episodes submitted so far have been approved. Conditions: Standard license guarantees placement on Roku, Apple TV, and Fire TV via ISTV app.; VIP license includes submission to Amazon, but approval is not guaranteed. Boundaries: This does not guarantee Amazon placement for any license.; This does not imply clients can select a specific platform from the guaranteed list.
